headline: Wardens Reclaim Linn Mercy Post as Berm Front Boils
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition went to press, Linn Mercy has turned part way back: Warden forces hold a base there once more, cutting the Colonial count to nine with one field still in ruin, and the fighting has only thickened — the day's ledger now reads 9,426 Colonial and 16,692 Warden, with two-hour loss rates still climbing. Palantine Berm is the busiest ground on the map: ten ownership actions in two hours, thirty-six in the day, two posts reduced to no-man's-land, and the balance standing three Colonial to two Warden. Fresh actions were logged up to the filing hour along the Nevish Line, now six Warden bases to two Colonial, and in the Weathered Expanse, where six Warden, one Colonial and two ruined posts stand. In Marban Hollow, Checkpoint Bua has changed hands time and again — twenty-three events in a day. The Gutter, unchanged on the map since Suojus fell before dawn, shows loss rates surging anew, with two-hour tolls of 182 Colonial and 162 Warden. Mooring County and Kuura Strand have been still for hours. Day 592 of the war; thirty-four victory towns required; no victor named.
